verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant work programmatically inside the workspace. Through it, an agent can list audits and evidence requests and add comments, attachments, and status updates, which is a documented machine interface for driving the product. However, no general-purpose public REST/GraphQL API, endpoint reference, or auth/token documentation appears in the evidence, so the interface is limited to the MCP tool surface. Missing for 10: documented public REST/GraphQL API reference, API authentication/keys docs, broad endpoint coverage beyond audits and evidence requests, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
